## Merge Strategy Recommendations

### Priority 1: Sync with `origin/main` (CRITICAL)

**Why:** Main is the production branch. 24 commits behind means HEAD is missing production-critical changes.

**Strategy:**
```bash
# Step 1: Backup current branch
git branch backup/feature-github-mcp-setup-$(date +%Y%m%d)

# Step 2: Attempt merge
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main --no-edit

# Step 3: If conflicts in .github/workflows/ → prefer origin/main (production CI)
# Step 4: If conflicts in .planning/ → concatenate (docs are additive)
# Step 5: Verify compilation
cargo check --package oms-engine --lib

# Step 6: Commit merge
git commit -m "merge: Sync feature/github-mcp-setup with origin/main resolving diverged configs"
```

**Expected Conflicts:** `.github/workflows/*.yml`, `.planning/*.md`
**Resolution Time:** 15-30 minutes
**Risk if Deferred:** Main moves further ahead, merge debt increases exponentially.

---

### Priority 2: Sync with `origin/develop` (HIGH)

**Why:** Develop is the integration branch. 15 commits behind means missing integration work.

**Strategy:**
```bash
git fetch origin develop
# Since HEAD is ahead by 39, try rebase onto develop
git rebase origin/develop
# If conflicts: resolve per same rules as main
```

**Alternative (if rebase too complex):**
```bash
git merge origin/develop --no-edit

```

## Autonomous Sync Execution Plan

### Phase A: Local Preparation (No GitHub)

```bash
# 1. Create backup branch
git branch backup/feature-github-mcp-setup-$(date +%Y%m%d)

# 2. Fetch all remotes (local cache only)
git fetch --all

# 3. Test merge with main (dry run)
git merge-tree $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD origin/main
# If output contains "===", conflicts exist
```

### Phase B: Merge Execution

```bash
# 1. Merge main first (production baseline)
git merge origin/main --no-edit
# Resolve any conflicts

# 2. Merge develop (integration branch)
git merge origin/develop --no-edit
# Resolve any conflicts

# 3. Merge sentinel-nexus
ngit merge origin/sentinel-nexus-integration --no-edit

# 4. Verify all merges

# 3. Commit message audit

# Verify conventional commit format
```

## Risk Mitigation

| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Merge conflicts in CI workflows | HIGH | CI breaks | Prefer origin/main for workflows, test post-merge |
| Merge conflicts in .planning/ | MEDIUM | Docs out of sync | Concatenate additive docs, prefer newest |
| Compilation errors post-merge | LOW | Build breaks | Run cargo check after each merge |
| Force push on shared branches | MEDIUM | Data loss | Use merge commits instead of force push |
| GitHub unavailable during push | LOW | Sync blocked | Work in local branches, push when available |
| Rollback needed | LOW | Lost work | Backup branch created before merge |
